headers: Skyborne Protection Warrior levelling route for WoW Forever (Alliance, 1H + shield, Skinning + Mining), generated from the Forever Alliance guide by tooling/build_variant.py. 2026.11.01: first full build - Zephras Isle 1-14 (two hand-written chapters), the Dalaran-Stormwind-Ironforge join leg, then chapters 02-26 with the warrior class thread (Wu Shen / Kelv / Arias'ta trainer stops, Exploring the Alliance, Journey to Sentinel Hill, the Fire Hardened chain to The Shieldsmith), prot gear calls after every reward, tank notes and per-boss loot calls in every dungeon. Unverified items are marked in the text; the test list is docs/warrior-build-2026-11-01.md. 2026.11.01 (second pass): the optional Classic warrior weapon chain (Bartleby in Stormwind, Tormus Deepforge in Ironforge, Umbral weapons in 11-15 Loch Modan, Marshal Haggard and Dead-tooth Jack in 26-27 Redridge and Eastvale); the Guard's-set AH remarks cut (bind on pickup). Research pass (Wowhead Forever, nether tooltips, Blizzard's Skyborne post): the Bulwark hand-in moved to right after the Zaal kill (it teaches Defensive Stance), the Feathers for Binding budget set from its 27.5% drop rate (~73 kills; it gates the Nightfang Den chain), drop rates and recipe skills written in, racials corrected (1% haste), Dead-Tooth Jack and the Dark Iron Map rates, trainer-rank caveats dropped. 2026.11.01 (release check): the Mor'Ladim chain total in 25-26 corrected to 5,340 XP; Darnassus, Razorfen Kraul and Gnomeregan XP refreshed from Wowhead; a quoted-XP check added to the tooling. 2 Nov: QuestieDB 1.0.10 + client 1.60.1.70753: Incinerator Gar'im and Baron Marinous (GROUP 2+) noted as elite, crocolisk spawn count 19, Wowhead XP re-pulled for every route zone (no change), tooltips refreshed. 2 Nov (evening): item 2454 named correctly (Elixir of Lion's Strength) in 6-14 Zephras Isle; the Dun Morogh road XP in the join leg corrected to 3,320 (+660 for Ironband's Compound); 19-20 Deadmines rebinds the hearth at Sentinel Hill (Redridge had bound it at Lakeshire). 2 Nov (research pass): Skyborne racial values updated to the 26 Oct beta notes, the Shen'dar profession trainers confirmed and the Stormwind AH position filled in. 3 Nov: the Menethil trout stop at 21-22 (chapter 09) now says the +5 Strong Fishing Pole makes it a long shot; rebuilt on the 3 Nov shaman source. 4 Nov: rebuilt on the 4 Nov shaman source (launch audit of 02-26: trainer, vendor, loot and skill-up steps hold until the action is done instead of completing on arrival; vendor prices and quest-money checks; an entrance step before every cave or interior target - see docs/audit-2026-11-04.md); the level-22 Wu Shen stop re-anchored before the walk to Goldshire after the shaman's tram line was cut. 5 Nov: rebuilt on the 5 Nov source (chapter 02 gold check: smelt, sell surplus bars and stone on the AH, keep the crate and bronze reserve). 5 Nov (money check): the chapter 02 and 08 gold checks rewritten for this route - about 1g of quest money by Ironforge and about 3g 70s by the Ruins (Wowhead quest data), the shaman's spells, axe skill and pole dropped from the shopping list; class training is not priced yet. Flint and Tinder 1s 32c (02).
